title: 2026 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Horse
seo_title: 2026 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Horse (17 February – 5 February 2027)
description: 2026 is the Year of the Fire Horse (Yang, Bing-wu), from 17 February 2026 to 5 February 2027. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2026.
lead: Born in 2026? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Horse, but check the date: the 2026 Fire Horse year began on 17 February 2026. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2026: Year of the Fire Horse, from 17 February 2026 to 5 February 2027.

image.alt: Golden Horse of the Chinese zodiac in front of a moonlit temple
image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2026 is the Year of the Horse. It began with Lunar New Year on 17 February 2026 and ends on 5 February 2027, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2026 ends in 6, which makes it a Fire year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2026 is a Bing-wu year. The same Fire Horse combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1966 before it and 2086 after it.
Lunar New Year 2026 fell on 17 February 2026, so everyone born in January 2026, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Snake.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Horse guide describes the sign like this: “Energetic, independent, and adventurous. Horses love freedom and new experiences.” The usual watch-out: “Can be impatient or struggle to commit long-term.”

The Fire element adds its own flavour. Fire years bring passion, energy, and boldness. People of this element tend to be dynamic, adventurous, and quick to lead. Read more in our Fire element guide, or the full Year of the Horse page.
Careers often linked with the Horse: travel, sales, sports, media.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2026
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Horse's best matches are the Tiger, Goat and Dog, and its clash sign is the Rat, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Horse, 2026 is a Horse year, so Horse people are in their own year (ben ming nian) until 5 February 2027.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Horse, it is listed as a supportive match of the Goat, so 2027 is traditionally a friendly year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Horse years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 2002 (Water Horse); 2014 (Wood Horse); 2038 (Earth Horse). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2026 is the Year of the Horse, a Yang Fire Horse year (Bing-wu).
When does the 2026 Year of the Horse start and end?
It starts on 17 February 2026 and ends on 5 February 2027.
I was born in January 2026. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Snake: Lunar New Year 2026 was on 17 February 2026, so all of January 2026 belongs to the Snake year.
Fire. 2026 ends in 6, which belongs to Fire, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Horse compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Goat and Dog. The Horse's clash sign is the Rat.
